title: Habits and the general present
summary: Meet Turkmen's second present, the general present in `-Ar` (*geler*, *okar*, *işlär*), with its negative in `-mAr` and `-mAz` (*gelmerin*, *gelmez*), and use it for what is always so, habits, guesses, promises and offers (*Ertir jaň ederin*, *Çaý içersiňizmi?*), choosing it or `-ýAr` with care.
canDo: Say what you and others usually, often, sometimes or never do
Say what is always so, and guess what will happen
Promise something, and offer tea politely
Choose between -ýAr and -Ar for now, habits, plans and promises
